scope: forty-fourth batch: the second master-data slice — the client-record field rules the store applies (length limits, empty means unset, the writable field whitelists, the colour default, and the create-versus-update cleaning difference)

live_source.start_capture_note: no separate start capture was taken this batch; the before-snapshot is the forty-third batch delivery, which proves the live source did not change between that delivery and this one, not the identity at the moment work started
live_source.delivery_compare_command: cowork-migration-baseline.py compare baseline-forty-third-delivery.json baseline-forty-fourth-delivery.json (before pinned at 2e21cbb0, after pinned at ca98ef87)
live_source.source_note: the ported rules are pure; the pinned functions are executed against a recording cursor in the differential

covers: surrounding space goes and an empty value becomes unset; a value is cut to its deployed limit while one under the limit is untouched; non-text is stringified

a client without a name is not created, the fields are cleaned, empty stays unset, the colour defaults, an explicit colour is kept, and the create path takes a truthy colour as given (the deployed quirk) while the update path cleans and cuts it
the buyer catalogue fields are accepted and unknown fields are dropped; create does not accept is_active, as deployed

update writes only the fields that were given, None means leave it alone, nothing to write returns nothing, an emptied text becomes unset, is_active stays a flag, and the whitelist excludes the scope fields

checks.note: the pinned create/update write through a cursor, so the cursor is the device replaced: it records the statement and its parameters and the test rebuilds the columns the pinned code would have written in deployed column order. Non-string text values are deliberately outside the comparison because the pinned code calls .strip() on them and swallows the error (no client is created at all), while this side stringifies; that difference is recorded in the intentional differences rather than hidden by the fixture.

checks.command: docker exec ... python -m unittest test_cowork_client_records test_cowork_buyer_resolve test_cowork_document_tier test_cowork_reconciliation_bank_intake
checks.note: the new module is independent of the OCR work; the previous batches' suites are run to confirm nothing regressed

intentional_differences: for a non-string text value the pinned code raises inside .strip() and swallows it, so the whole create silently does nothing; this side stringifies instead. The port is strictly more permissive and never silently drops a create, and the differential fixture therefore only carries strings
this slice returns cleaned field values only; the deployed return values (a new row id, or whether the update matched a row) belong to the store, which is the next batch

the create path keeps a truthy colour exactly as given (no strip, no length cut) because that is what the deployed create does; only the update path cleans and cuts it. The first draft of this port cleaned both and the differential caught it
comments and docstrings were rewritten; every limit, every whitelist, the default colour, the empty-means-unset rule and the blank-name refusal are the deployed ones
not_run: any storage layer or DocType change, the roster RPCs, the import normalisation, supplier and product master data, real client data, the frontend, deployment, external results and user acceptance
